Chicken Adobo

45 min (mostly hands-off)EasyServes 1–4

Prep — Braising in Soy, Vinegar & Bay Leaf

Ingredients by Serving

Ingredient1234
Chicken thighs/drumsticks, bone-in150g300g450g600g
Soy sauce20ml40ml60ml80ml
White cane vinegar20ml40ml60ml80ml
Garlic cloves, crushed2468
Bay leaves1234
Whole peppercorns¼ tsp½ tsp¾ tsp1 tsp
Brown sugar¼ tsp½ tsp¾ tsp1 tsp
Water60ml120ml180ml240ml
Cooking oil5ml10ml15ml20ml
Steamed rice (to serve)150g300g450g600g

Steps

  1. Marinate the chicken in soy sauce and garlic 15-30 minutes.
  2. Sear the chicken skin-side down in oil 3-4 minutes per side until golden.
  3. Add the reserved marinade, vinegar, water, bay leaves, peppercorns, and sugar.
  4. Boil uncovered without stirring 3 minutes to cook off the vinegar's raw sharpness.
  5. Cover, reduce to a simmer, and cook 25-30 minutes until the chicken is fork-tender.
  6. Uncover and simmer 5-8 more minutes until the sauce reduces to a glossy glaze.
  7. Taste and adjust the salty-sour-sweet balance.
  8. Serve hot over steamed rice, spooning the glaze over the top.

Pork Sinigang (Sour Tamarind Soup)

60 minEasyServes 1–4

Prep — Sinigang Vegetables

Ingredients by Serving

Ingredient1234
Pork belly or ribs, cubed150g300g450g600g
Water500ml1000ml1500ml2000ml
Onion, quartered¼½¾1
Tomato, quartered½11½2
Tamarind soup base (or paste)10g20g30g40g
Radish (labanos), sliced30g60g90g120g
Eggplant, sliced30g60g90g120g
Long green chili1234
String beans (sitaw), cut20g40g60g80g
Kangkong or spinach30g60g90g120g
Fish sauce (patis)5ml10ml15ml20ml

Steps

  1. Boil the pork with onion and tomato, skimming foam, then simmer 40-45 minutes until tender.
  2. Stir in the tamarind soup base until dissolved and the broth turns sour.
  3. Add the radish and eggplant, simmer 5 minutes.
  4. Add the string beans and chili, simmer 3-4 minutes more.
  5. Season with fish sauce to taste.
  6. Stir in the kangkong or spinach last and cook 1 minute until just wilted.
  7. Ladle into bowls and serve hot with rice, extra fish sauce, and calamansi.

Pancit Canton (Stir-Fried Noodles)

35 minMediumServes 1–4

Prep — A Tray of Freshly Tossed Noodles

Ingredients by Serving

Ingredient1234
Pancit canton noodles (dried)60g120g180g240g
Pork, thinly sliced60g120g180g240g
Shrimp, peeled50g100g150g200g
Garlic, minced1 clove2 cloves3 cloves4 cloves
Onion, sliced20g40g60g80g
Cabbage, shredded50g100g150g200g
Carrot, julienned30g60g90g120g
Snow peas (sitsaro)20g40g60g80g
Chicken broth100ml200ml300ml400ml
Soy sauce10ml20ml30ml40ml
Oyster sauce10ml20ml30ml40ml
Cooking oil10ml20ml30ml40ml
Black pepperpinchpinch¼ tsp¼ tsp
Calamansi or lime wedges1234

Steps

  1. Soak the dried noodles in warm water 5-10 minutes until pliable, then drain.
  2. Sauté the garlic and onion 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
  3. Add the pork, cook until no longer pink, then add shrimp and cook until opaque.
  4. Pour in the chicken broth, soy sauce, and oyster sauce, and bring to a simmer.
  5. Add the carrot, then the cabbage and snow peas, cooking until crisp-tender.
  6. Add the drained noodles and toss 3-5 minutes until they absorb the liquid.
  7. Season with black pepper to taste.
  8. Serve hot with calamansi or lime wedges squeezed over the top.

Chicken Tinola

40 minEasyServes 1–4

Prep — Chicken, Chayote & Aromatics

Ingredients by Serving

Ingredient1234
Chicken thighs/drumsticks, cut up150g300g450g600g
Fresh ginger, sliced10g20g30g40g
Garlic cloves, crushed1234
Onion, sliced20g40g60g80g
Green papaya (or chayote), sliced60g120g180g240g
Malunggay leaves (or baby spinach)15g30g45g60g
Fish sauce (patis)5ml10ml15ml20ml
Water or chicken broth300ml600ml900ml1200ml
Cooking oil5ml10ml15ml20ml

Steps

  1. Sauté the ginger 1-2 minutes, then add the garlic and onion and cook 2 minutes.
  2. Add the chicken and cook 3-4 minutes, stirring, until lightly browned.
  3. Pour in the fish sauce, then add the water or broth.
  4. Bring to a boil, then simmer covered partway 20-25 minutes until the chicken is tender.
  5. Add the green papaya or chayote and simmer 5-8 minutes until just tender.
  6. Stir in the malunggay or spinach and simmer 1-2 minutes until wilted.
  7. Taste and add more fish sauce if needed.
  8. Serve hot in bowls with steamed rice alongside.

Bicol Express (Spicy Pork in Coconut Milk)

40 minMediumServes 1–4

Prep — Sautéed Shrimp Paste (Bagoong)

Ingredients by Serving

Ingredient1234
Pork belly, sliced or cubed130g260g390g520g
Coconut milk100ml200ml300ml400ml
Shrimp paste (bagoong alamang)10g20g30g40g
Garlic, minced1 clove2 cloves3 cloves4 cloves
Onion, chopped20g40g60g80g
Fresh ginger, minced5g10g15g20g
Long green chilies, sliced2468
Thai chilies (siling labuyo), sliced1234
Cooking oil5ml10ml15ml20ml

Steps

  1. Sauté the garlic, onion, and ginger 2-3 minutes until fragrant.
  2. Add the pork and cook 4-5 minutes until lightly browned at the edges.
  3. Stir in the shrimp paste and cook 1 minute until it darkens and smells toasty.
  4. Pour in the coconut milk, stirring to combine.
  5. Simmer gently, uncovered, 25-30 minutes until the pork is tender and the sauce thickens.
  6. Add the long green chilies and simmer 5 minutes.
  7. Stir in the Thai chilies for the final 2 minutes, to taste.
  8. Serve over steamed rice.

Beef Caldereta

90 min (mostly hands-off)MediumServes 1–4

Prep — Liver Spread, the Signature Ingredient

Ingredients by Serving

Ingredient1234
Beef chuck, cubed150g300g450g600g
Liver spread15g30g45g60g
Tomato sauce60g120g180g240g
Beef broth or water150ml300ml450ml600ml
Potato, cubed50g100g150g200g
Carrot, sliced40g80g120g160g
Red bell pepper, sliced¼½¾1
Green bell pepper, sliced¼½¾1
Pitted green olives, sliced15g30g45g60g
Onion, chopped25g50g75g100g
Garlic, minced1 clove2 cloves3 cloves4 cloves
Bay leaf¼½¾1
Quickmelt cheese, shredded (optional)15g30g45g60g
Cooking oil10ml20ml30ml40ml
Saltpinchpinch¼ tsp¼ tsp

Steps

  1. Brown the beef in batches, 3-4 minutes per side, then set aside.
  2. Sauté the onion and garlic 2-3 minutes until softened.
  3. Return the beef to the pot with tomato sauce, broth, and bay leaf; bring to a boil.
  4. Cover partway and simmer 60-75 minutes until the beef is fork-tender.
  5. Add the potato and carrot, simmer 10-12 minutes until just tender.
  6. Stir in the liver spread until it dissolves and thickens the sauce.
  7. Add the bell peppers and green olives, simmer 5 minutes until just softened.
  8. Stir in the shredded cheese, if using, until melted.
  9. Season with salt and serve hot over steamed rice.

Lumpia Shanghai (Fried Spring Rolls)

45 minMediumServes 1–4

Prep — Hand-Rolled and Fried

Ingredients by Serving

Ingredient1234
Ground pork150g300g450g600g
Carrot, finely minced30g60g90g120g
Green onion, minced10g20g30g40g
Garlic, minced1 clove2 cloves3 cloves4 cloves
Egg (binder + sealing)½11½2
Soy sauce10ml20ml30ml40ml
Salt & pepperpinchpinch¼ tsp¼ tsp
Lumpia/spring roll wrappers8162432
Oil, for frying250ml500ml750ml1000ml
Steamed rice (to serve)150g300g450g600g
Sweet chili sauce or banana ketchup15ml30ml45ml60ml

Steps

  1. Mix the ground pork, carrot, green onion, garlic, soy sauce, salt, and pepper until slightly sticky.
  2. Spoon a log of filling near the bottom corner of a wrapper laid in a diamond orientation.
  3. Fold the bottom corner over the filling, fold in the sides, and roll tightly.
  4. Seal the top corner with a dab of beaten egg. Repeat with remaining wrappers.
  5. Heat the oil to about 175°C (350°F).
  6. Fry the rolls in batches, turning occasionally, 4-5 minutes until deep golden and crisp.
  7. Drain on paper towels or a wire rack.
  8. Serve hot over rice with sweet chili sauce or banana ketchup for dipping.

Leche Flan (Bonus)

40 min (+ 4 hr chill)EasyServes 1–4

Prep — Steamed Custard, Sliced

Ingredients by Serving

Ingredient1234
Egg yolks36912
Condensed milk60ml120ml180ml240ml
Evaporated milk60ml120ml180ml240ml
Vanilla extract¼ tsp½ tsp¾ tsp1 tsp
Calamansi or lemon zest (optional)pinchpinch¼ tsp¼ tsp
Sugar (for caramel)30g60g90g120g
Water (for caramel)10ml20ml30ml40ml

Steps

  1. Melt the sugar with water in a llanera or small mold until deep amber, then swirl to coat the bottom.
  2. Whisk the egg yolks gently, just enough to break them up.
  3. Stir in the condensed milk, evaporated milk, vanilla, and zest until smooth.
  4. Strain the mixture into the mold over the hardened caramel.
  5. Cover the mold tightly with foil.
  6. Steam over gently simmering water 25-30 minutes until set but still slightly jiggly.
  7. Cool to room temperature, then refrigerate at least 4 hours.
  8. Unmold onto a plate so the caramel pools over the custard, then slice and serve chilled.
